non_findings_and_controls: Cancellation requires an approved reason code, uses an atomic status-conditional update, logs the actor, and closes any still-open visit/workflow in the same transaction. No separate cancel candidate confirmed in the inspected path.

undo_checkin is role/capability gated, refuses after downstream clinical work, returns appointment to CONFIRMED, marks only open visit incomplete, and cancels waiting/called queue entries. Existing tests cover undo and re-check-in; no new issue confirmed.

Declined appointment recovery uses the reassign transition from DOCTOR_DECLINED to CONFIRMED. Legacy decline is not an active transition in the state table; no new candidate confirmed in inspected callers.
Concurrent status actions are compare-and-set by status in _update / check_in_appointment; existing race finding CLIN-005 was not restated.
Reschedule of CHECKED_IN retaining a stale queue/service relationship is already on the CLIN-010 surface; no separate finding created from that overlapping trigger.
explicit_limitations: BookingService and all route/UI/test files were read selectively; there is no full-module or repository-wide coverage claim.
Database migrations and runtime behavior were not executed or inspected as part of this lifecycle slice.
The product's no-show grace period is not specified in the inspected boundary, so the finding does not invent a duration.
